insight: Specializes in generative-media latency — FLUX, Kling, Veo and 600+ media models — where general inference hosts focus on text.
name: fal
tagline: Serverless inference API for image, video, audio, and 3D models.
description: A generative-media inference platform exposing FLUX, Kling, Veo, Wan, Stable Diffusion, and 600+ image/video/audio/3D models through one fast, serverless API — no GPUs to manage and near-zero cold starts. Pay per output or per GPU-second; free starter credits to test. Popular as the production backend for AI media features.

modelSupport.notes: Unified API to 600+ open and commercial generative-media models.
